descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo ruolo con noi

Lei sostiene il direttore della boutique nel guidare la squadra di sei membri e lo rappresenta in sua assenza
Sei attivamente coinvolto nelle vendite e consiglia ai nostri clienti nazionali e internazionali esigenti sull'acquisto di gioielli di alta qualità
Creano un'esperienza cliente personalizzata, costruiscono relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e presentano i nostri gioielli con un'esperienza approfondita
Insieme al team, contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di ricavi e servizi e garantirai il rispetto dei nostri standard di vendita, servizio e CRM.
Sostengono la pianificazione delle operazioni e assicurano un funzionamento regolare del business quotidiano, così come aree di vendita perfettamente presentate e vetrine
Essi prendono il controllo amministrativo
• Compiti e supporto agli eventi dei clienti e ai progetti selezionati

Ecco cosa portano con loro.

Formazione completa nel commercio al dettaglio, idealmente con un focus sui gioielli, o una formazione comparabile
Diversi anni di esperienza di vendita nel segmento di lusso, esperienza approfondita nel settore dei gioielli e piacere nel consigliare clienti nazionali e internazionali
L'esperienza iniziale nella gestione professionale o in una funzione responsabile comparabile è un vantaggio
Forte forza di vendita così come un alto livello di servizio e orientamento del cliente
Difficoltà nell'accompagnare, sostenere e motivare i dipendenti nel business quotidiano
Un senso di responsabilità, capacità organizzative e un metodo di lavoro indipendente
Aspetto sicuro, professionale ed elegante così come maniere cortesi
Buona conoscenza IT, esperienza ideale nel trattare i sistemi CRM
Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese, altre lingue sono un vantaggio
Prontezza a lavorare in servizio anticipato e tardivo durante le ore di apertura del GLOBUS Zurigo, dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 10.00 alle 20.00 e sabato dalle 09.00 alle 20.00
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

You support the boutique manager in leading the six-member team and represent him in his absence
You are actively involved in sales and advise our demanding national and international customers on the purchase of high-quality jewelry
They create a personalized customer experience, build long-term customer relationships and present our jewelry with in-depth expertise
Together with the team, you will contribute to the achievement of revenue and service goals and ensure compliance with our sales, service and CRM standards.
They support the planning of operations and ensure a smooth running of daily business as well as flawlessly presented sales areas and display cases
They take over administrative
• Tasks and support customer events and selected projects

This is what they bring with them.

Completed training in the retail trade, ideally with a focus on jewellery, or a comparable training
Several years of sales experience in the luxury segment, in-depth expertise in the jewelry sector and pleasure in advising national and international customers
Initial experience in professional management or in a comparable responsible function is an advantage
Strong sales strength as well as a high level of service and customer orientation
Delight in accompanying, supporting and motivating employees in day-to-day business
A sense of responsibility, organisational skills and an independent working method
Safe, professional and stylish appearance as well as courteous manners
Good IT knowledge, ideally experience in dealing with CRM systems
Very good German and English skills, other languages are an advantage
Readiness to work in early and late service during the Öopening hours of the GLOBUS Zurich, from Monday to Friday between 10.00 and 20.00 and on Saturday between 09.00 and 20.00
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihre Rolle bei uns

Sie unterstützen den Boutique Manager bei der Führung des sechsköpfigen Teams und vertreten ihn bei Abwesenheit
Sie sind aktiv im Verkauf tätig und beraten unsere anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Kunden beim Kauf hochwertiger Schmuckstücke
Sie schaffen ein persönliches Kundenerlebnis, bauen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und präsentieren unsere Schmuckstücke mit fundiertem Fachwissen
Gemeinsam mit dem Team tragen Sie zur Erreichung der Umsatz- und Serviceziele bei und stellen die Einhaltung unserer Verkaufs-, Service- und CRM-Standards sicher
Sie unterstützen bei der Einsatzplanung und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf des Tagesgeschäfts sowie einwandfrei präsentierte Verkaufsflächen und Vitrinen
Sie übernehmen administrative
• Aufgaben und unterstützen bei Kundenveranstaltungen sowie ausgewählten Projekten

Das bringen Sie mit

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Schmuck, oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
Mehrjährige Verkaufserfahrung im Luxussegment, fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Schmuckbereich und Freude an der Beratung nationaler und internationaler Kundschaft
Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Funktion sind von Vorteil
Ausgeprägte Verkaufsstärke sowie eine hohe Service- und Kundenorientierung
Freude daran, Mitarbeitende im Tagesgeschäft zu begleiten, zu unterstützen und zu motivieren
Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationsgeschick und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise
Sicheres, professionelles und stilvolles Auftreten sowie zuvorkommende Umgangsformen
Gute IT-Kenntnisse, idealerweise Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil
Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Früh- und Spätdienst während der Öffnungszeiten des GLOBUS Zürich, von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 10.00 und 20.00 Uhr sowie am Samstag zwischen 09.00 und 20.00 Uhr
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre rôle avec nous

Vous soutenez le directeur de boutique en dirigeant l'équipe de six membres et le représentez en son absence
Vous êtes activement impliqué dans les ventes et conseillez nos clients nationaux et internationaux exigeants sur l'achat de bijoux de haute qualité
Ils créent une expérience client personnalisée, établissent des relations client à long terme et présentent nos bijoux avec une expertise approfondie
Avec l'équipe, vous contribuerez à la réalisation des objectifs de revenus et de services et assurerez le respect de nos normes de ventes, de service et de CRM.
Ils soutiennent la planification des opérations et assurent le bon fonctionnement des affaires quotidiennes ainsi que des zones de vente et des vitrines présentés sans faille
Ils prennent le contrôle administratif
• Tâches et soutien aux événements clients et projets sélectionnés

C'est ce qu'ils apportent.

Formation terminée dans le commerce de détail, idéalement axée sur la joaillerie, ou formation comparable
Plusieurs années d'expérience commerciale dans le secteur du luxe, une expertise approfondie dans le secteur de la bijouterie et le plaisir de conseiller les clients nationaux et internationaux
L'expérience initiale en gestion professionnelle ou dans une fonction responsable comparable est un avantage
Forte force des ventes ainsi qu'un niveau élevé de service et d'orientation des clients
Délice d'accompagner, de soutenir et de motiver les employés dans les affaires quotidiennes
Un sens des responsabilités, des compétences organisationnelles et une méthode de travail indépendante
Une apparence sûre, professionnelle et élégante ainsi que des manières courtoises
Bonne connaissance informatique, idéalement expérience dans le traitement des systèmes CRM
Très bonnes compétences en allemand et anglais, d'autres langues sont un avantage
Préparation au travail en début et en fin de service pendant les heures d'ouverture du GLOBUS Zurich, du lundi au vendredi entre 10h00 et 20h00 et le samedi entre 9h00 et 20h00

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Ensuring first-class jewelry customer service for all Bucherer retail stores in Switzerland and internationally
• Acting as the central liaison between our sales teams, jewelry suppliers, and internal departments
• Coordinating and monitoring product transfers between locations
• Independently handling individual customer orders
• Preparing and following up on quotations
• Taking responsibility for a variety of administrative and organizational tasks

What you bring to the role

• Completed commercial apprenticeship or retail training with experience in administrative/commercial tasks
• Experience in the jewelry, watch, or luxury goods industry is an advantage
• Strong service and customer orientation combined with a high standard of quality
• Independent, structured, and precise working style, along with excellent organizational skills
• Confident use of common MS Office applications and ERP systems
• High level of resilience, flexibility, and reliability, even in a dynamic environment
• Team-oriented personality with a professional and polished appearance
• Quick comprehension skills and enthusiasm for taking on responsibility
• Excellent German language skills and good written and spoken English skills

Remote work is not possible for this position.

Your role with us

• Lead and develop a team of two employees within the Sourcing and GemLab function
• Implement and further develop sourcing strategies
• Coordinate customer inquiries and manage the quotation process
• Source gemstones and diamonds for stock, bespoke orders, and sales activities
• Support Category Management in assortment and sourcing-related topics
• Maintain and further develop supplier relationships
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional internal stakeholders
• Drive continuous improvement of processes and workflows within the area of responsibility

What you bring to the role

• Commercial vocational training combined with further education in business administration
• Several years of professional experience in the jewellery, gemstone, or diamond industry
• Solid expertise in gemstones and diamonds; gemmological training is an advantage
• Enthusiasm for leading and developing a small team
• Entrepreneurial mindset, strong initiative, and a hands-on approach
• Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills
• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Overall responsibility for the operational management of the Watch Service Atelier in Lucerne, with a strong focus on quality, productivity, and on-time delivery
• Manage and optimize processes, resources, and workflows to achieve defined KPI targets
• Ensure and continuously develop quality standards and quality control processes
• Lead, coach, and develop the workshop team, both professionally and personally
• Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and continuously learning team culture
• Work closely with internal stakeholders and international service centers to implement global standards and best practices

What you bring to the role

• Completed apprenticeship as a Watchmaker (EFZ), specializing in after-sales service (Rhabillage) or industrial watchmaking
• Several years of professional experience in watch servicing, ideally complemented by leadership experience
• Additional training in leadership, management, or business administration is an advantage
• Strong leadership and communication skills, combined with a structured and analytical approach to work
• High quality orientation, entrepreneurial mindset, and experience collaborating with diverse teams and cultures
• Hands-on mentality, resilience, and a team-oriented personality focused on sustainable results and continuous improvement
• Fluent German and English language skills; knowledge of French is an asset

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Responsible for the administrative management of the Watch Service, with a focus on the Swiss market
• Coordination and monitoring of internal and external repair schedules
• Maintenance and assurance of high-quality customer, product, and order data within the repair management system
• Ensuring, optimizing, and continuously developing existing processes
• Acting as the escalation point for complex customer inquiries and concerns
• Managing and monitoring service orders throughout the entire repair process
• Further developing quality standards to ensure an excellent Watch Service customer journey
• Contributing to the development and enhancement of Power BI reporting and the analysis of relevant KPIs
• Participating in and taking partial responsibility for global projects
• Deputizing for the Global Head of Watch Service Administration in administrative and coordination-related matters

What you bring to the role

Commercial apprenticeship or retail-specific vocational qualification (EFZ) supplemented by further education in business administration or project management (e.g., Federal Diploma of Higher Education, HF Diploma, or equivalent qualification)
• Several years of professional experience in a demanding administrative role, ideally within the luxury goods industry
• Experience in supporting, coordinating, or taking partial responsibility for projects
• Strong ERP system knowledge, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations; Power BI knowledge is an advantage
• Excellent written and spoken German and English skills (C1 level); French and additional languages are considered an asset
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to think holistically and identify interconnected relationships
• High level of resilience, ability to work under pressure, and confidence in decision-making, including in deputy and escalation situations
• Independent, customer-oriented, and assertive personality with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and proactive approach to work

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Independent planning, implementation and management of global IT projects in the areas of networking, WLAN and IP telephony
• Installation, configuration and operation of network components with a focus on Cisco and Fortinet
• Further development and implementation of global network and security concepts for high availability, stability and scalability
• Administration, monitoring and troubleshooting of the international LAN/WLAN infrastructure (Cisco hardware & software)
• Automation and scripting (e.g. with Ansible, Python) for standardisation and increased efficiency
• Compliance with and monitoring of IT security standards, including firewall, VPN and access control concepts
• Carrying out installations and technical assignments in our international sales outlets
• Collaboration with internal departments as well as external service providers and partners
• Collaboration in global incident, problem and change processes in accordance with ITIL standards

Your skills

• Completed IT training or comparable qualification and at least 3 years of professional experience in the network environment
• Very good knowledge of routing, switching, WLAN, VLAN design and network security
• Several years of experience with Cisco (switching/wireless/VoIP) and ideally Fortinet
• In-depth experience with firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN and monitoring tools (e.g. PRTG, SolarWinds, Cisco Identity Services Engine)
• Good knowledge of scripting & automation (Ansible, Python)
• Confident written and spoken German and English
• Strong service orientation, analytical thinking, ability to work in a team and a proactive approach to work
• Willingness to travel internationally (EU/UK/US) and take on on-call duty

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us
• Responsibility for the efficient handling of all warehouse processes (goods receipt, putaway, order picking and dispatch)
• You will provide support as required across all operational areas (stand-in role)
• Ensuring timely and high-quality order processing, particularly of customer orders
• Monitoring, managing and optimising stock levels, including carrying out stock-takes
• Analysing existing warehousing processes and continuously developing and optimising them (e.g. LEAN approaches)
• Working closely with the Purchasing and Sales departments
• Ensuring compliance with quality and safety regulations
• Supporting the Warehousing Team Lead with optimisation projects and the development and maintenance of key performance indicators
• Assisting with the training of logistics apprentices

What you bring to the role
• A completed qualification in logistics (e.g. Logistics Specialist EFZ) or a technical/commercial qualification with relevant practical experience in logistics
• Several years’ professional experience in warehouse logistics
• A high degree of flexibility combined with a quick grasp of processes and expertise in all operational areas of logistics
• Experience in using warehouse management systems (e.g. SAP, WMS or Microsoft Dynamics)
• Good knowledge of MS Office (particularly Excel)
• Very good command of German and a basic knowledge of English
• Further training in logistics or supply chain management would be an advantage
• Strong IT skills and a passion for working with systems
• Strong process-oriented mindset and knowledge of LEAN management
• Structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work
• Analytical thinking and a good understanding of interrelationships
• Ability to work in a team, assertiveness, and a high degree of reliability and sense of responsibility
